# Azure Cloud Migrate — From AWS/GCP to Azure

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's cross-cloud migration skill: assess an existing workload, then migrate its code to Azure — Lambda to Azure Functions, Elastic Beanstalk/Heroku/App Engine to App Service, Fargate/Kubernetes/Cloud Run/Spring Boot to Container Apps — following phased scenario guides (assessment report first, then code conversion), auditing for cloud-specific gotchas like hardcoded Kubernetes DNS names, and handing off to azure-prepare for infrastructure and deployment. By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: assessment always comes before migration, by design — expect a report to review first; migrated code lands in a separate `<workspace>-azure/` folder and your source directory is never modified. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
